decision_clock: Use only the previous complete native session before the trade-date 09:29 America/New_York Stage1 feature decision; no same-day first-hour bars and no after-decision revisions.

preflight_stop: If the Qlib raw minute calendar does not cover all original Stage1 training sessions before 2023, stop source-only. Do not derive values, impute missing years, fit, replay, score 2023+ outcomes or tune a shorter historical window.
